quality.nonpositive_length_policy: Reference length uses positive values only; curvature is explicitly undefined for nonpositive-length rows. Finite measured positions/headings remain in primary metrics. A separate full-frame exclusion sensitivity recomputes kinematics with gap guards.
quality.qc_scope: Projected measurement inputs only; unselected pose/eye columns are not audited.
passed: positive reference length available; nonpositive values disclosed

scope: All valid observations of this trial; descriptive estimates, not independent samples or causal effects.

threshold_common_eligible.definition: Same frames eligible for every setting; eligible fish may differ. For threshold sweeps this is a selected high-relative-motion subset, not representative of the trial.

threshold_circulation_common_eligible.definition: Same frames eligible for every setting; eligible fish may differ. For threshold sweeps this is a selected high-relative-motion subset, not representative of the trial.

threshold_frame_selection.interpretation: Fixed baseline C sampled on each threshold-eligible frame set. Frames where baseline C is undefined are counted and excluded; especially relevant to the lower-threshold set.

window_common_eligible.definition: Same frames eligible for every setting; eligible fish may differ. For threshold sweeps this is a selected high-relative-motion subset, not representative of the trial.

leave_one_out_threshold_sensitivity.interpretation: Speed-threshold equivalent to subtracting the other-fish mean; directions and primary measurements unchanged. The tiny radius eligibility tolerance is retained.

heading_selection_sensitivity.iid_reference_note: sqrt(pi/(4*n)) approximates mean P for independent uniform headings. Illustrative only, not a calibrated null or subtraction/division correction; E[P squared]=1/n under that idealization.
heading_selection_sensitivity.interpretation: Raw uses all finite recorded headings; primary excludes an entire frame when any fish is heading-masked. Affected-fish-only sensitivity requires >=80% valid headings. Differences in medians describe selection and changing fish composition, not a correction.

matched_duration_sensitivity.definition: First min(target, available) sorted observed frames; kinematics recomputed with the truncated endpoint, retaining original segment/gap boundaries.

heading_selection_sensitivity.iid_reference_note: sqrt(pi/(4*n)) approximates mean P for independent uniform headings. Illustrative only, not a calibrated null or subtraction/division correction; E[P squared]=1/n under that idealization.
heading_selection_sensitivity.interpretation: Raw uses all finite recorded headings; primary excludes an entire frame when any fish is heading-masked. Affected-fish-only sensitivity requires >=80% valid headings. Differences in medians describe selection and changing fish composition, not a correction.

nonpositive_length_frame_exclusion_sensi.definition: Remove the complete frame whenever any fish has nonpositive body length, then recompute kinematics so smoothing never bridges the resulting gap. This is a sensitivity, not a claim that all retained finite primary positions/headings are correct. Own-set coverage uses retained frames; source-frame coverage is also recorded.

heading_diagnostics.interpretation: Flags reverse travel relative to tracked heading, not proven head-tail flips. Sustained intervals are not automatically excluded without video validation.
heading_diagnostics.mask_policy: Finite speed >= threshold; heading_valid is not used in the primary denominator or runs.

heading_selection_sensitivity.interpretation: Raw uses all finite recorded headings; primary excludes an entire frame when any fish is heading-masked. Affected-fish-only sensitivity requires >=80% valid headings. Differences in medians describe selection and changing fish composition, not a correction.

spatial_map.normalization: Counts divided by all focal observations and bin area; visible map need not integrate to one.

finite_N_note: Normalized circulation uses a finite number of dependent centroid-relative vectors; iid_direction_reference is illustrative, not a calibrated null or cross-N bias correction.
time_base_note: Track timestamps are used as provided; no independent camera-clock calibration performed in this comparison.
signed_circulation_note: Image-coordinate sign; do not compare chirality across cameras without verifying image orientation.
video_status: No new video overlays in this comparison; original 0066 pilot retains its three inspected examples.

matched_duration.selection: First min(17999, tracked_frame_count) sorted observed track frames

nonpositive_length_frame_exclusion_sensi.selection: Exclude whole caller-supplied frames with any nonpositive body length; retain all frames in primary metrics and raw-row QC

passed: stream and packed adjacency row counts
quality.coverage_policy: Whole missing frames are unknown; exclude them from denominators. Include zero-degree fish in covered frames.
